Seven-card stud it is. Here's how it works: everyone antes, then gets two down cards and one up card. After that come three more up cards (4th, 5th and 6th street) and a final down card on 7th street, with a betting round after each street. The best five of your seven cards wins, using standard hand rankings.

The table has two simplifications: each ante is 10, and there's no bring-in, so the highest up card acts first. Your bankroll starts at 1,000 and is 990 after your ante. The pot is 20.

On 3rd street you have a pair of 9s in the hole and an ace showing. Your ace is the high card, so you act first: check, bet 10 or fold.
